nom: Mario Badescu Super Collagen Mask with Marine Collagen

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily t-zone skin report the mask balances shine and controls the t-zone without over-drying, and one notes it improved acne-prone combo/oily skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe the mask as drying or tightening while it sits, but several say skin ends up soft and hydrated after moisturizing, though others found it genuinely worsened dryness or caused burning.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it clears blackheads and t-zone congestion but several also found it very drying, especially on the drier areas of the face.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: some say it is gentle, non-irritating and calming even used near the eyes, while others report burning, tingling, sneezing, rash or allergic reaction and do not recommend it for sensitive skin.
segments.normal: A reviewer with normal skin who never reacted to other brands reports severe dryness and new redness after first use.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing mature or aging skin report visibly reduced fine lines, firmer skin and a plumper, more youthful look, including under-eye improvement.

concerns.aging: Numerous reviewers report smoother, firmer skin and visibly reduced fine lines and wrinkles after use, some after a single application; a couple describe more modest, gradual improvement over consistent use.
concerns.dehydration: Reports are mixed: many describe skin as soft, plump and hydrated after moisturizing post-mask, while a substantial number describe the mask itself as very drying or even burning, particularly on dry, combination or sensitive skin.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including one with rosacea, report visible reduction in redness and calmer-looking skin; one reviewer instead reports new redness appearing on the cheeks after use.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers report no irritation even alongside retinol or acid use, describing the mask as soothing for compromised skin; others report burning, tingling, or a rash suggesting barrier irritation.
concerns.spots: Reviewers mention reduced acne scarring and faster fade of discoloration with consistent use; no dissent noted on this specific point.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report fewer breakouts, calmer skin, or blackheads and impurities drawn out, including one whose pimples reportedly popped on their own; one reviewer nonetheless found the product did nothing for their skin at all.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily t-zones report it feels balanced and less shiny after use, with pores appearing smaller; no negative reports specific to oil control were found.

aspects.libelle: Dries out and hardens in the jar
Smooth, creamy texture, easy to spread

extraits.texte: I have tried about 8-10 Mario Badescu products and have been loving them. I was excited to try this one, but I regret ever trying it. Things to know: I have sensitive skin, oily t-zone and the rest is dry. This product was not only hard to put on, but didn't smell good. I could get over the smell as long as it gave results but it obviously didn't work for me. Two minutes in, I began to sneeze several times and felt my skin was burning. I took it off right away and my skin was still tingling. Long story short: I'm allergic and now I have a rash on my face :(

I have sensitive combination skin for reference. When I first put the mask on I noticed the scent was strange and bothered me the whole time while wearing the mask. After taking it off, my skin felt dried out and burned after I put my moisturizer on. Overall I wanted to like this product but I don't think it was good for my sensitive skin!
I have combination skin and this was very drying. I'll try it again in the summer. Did feel it helped clear my T zone of black heads a bit.

I'm 40 and have had crepey, baggy skin under my eyes along with dark circles. I have recently been improving my skin care routine for my under eyes and in addition to more topical moisture, I've added this mask to my daily routine. I will only apply this mask to the area under my eyes ( I know it says to avoid the eye are in the instructions, but I have never gotten it in my eyes and it hasn't irritated my under eye area, even though I have SUPER sensitive skin). When I get up in the morning, I immediately apply while I prep my lunches and what not...then wash it off right before I'm getting ready to put my face on for the day. After rinsing off, the area under my eyes feel much tighter and looks smooth. I noticeably have less lines and the skin is not crepey.

extraits.titre: period life saver + great for dry skin
extraits.texte: I have super sensitive skin that breaks out to everything and this is great! I also have really dry skin from eczema, after I take it off I put a nice thick layer of lotion on and my skin is super soft! It's also great if you're like me and break out harde core on your period where it's not pimples, just random raised bumps and red inflamed skin! Takes away redness almost completely. If yours drys out (like mine did because I didn't put the lid on) just add some water and it's good as new!

I absolutely love this mask. I just bought it Monday and started using it Tuesday(today is Saturday), and I already see a difference in my skin tone. I've had rosacea for since early middle school(I'm 23 now), and this has really toned down the redness to give my skin an overall smoother, cooler look and feel to it. Keep in mind that due to quarantine in my state and me being sick this week, I haven't worn makeup at all since last week, and I've basically been living off green tea, but I still think this mask made a great impact on my skin! Nonetheless, it smells great and works well as a way to relax my skin at night. Highly recommend!

This mask just really firms everything up and makes it smooth. I have very dry skin and I can do this mask, add a good moisturizer after and I could leave the house with no makeup and feel good about it.
